lines.text: Elders who lead effectively deserve double honor, and Scripture says not to muzzle an ox treading out grain.
An accusation against an elder needs two or three witnesses, and persistent sinners are rebuked in front of everyone.
Paul charges Timothy before God, Christ Jesus and the elect angels to maintain these principles without bias.
Timothy must not be quick with laying on of hands, and he should drink a little milk, not only water.
Slaves should honor their masters so God's name is not discredited, and serve believing masters more because they are neighbors.
